nodes.description: transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable of UniswapExchange; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist gate using owner, UNI, pairFor derived _UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and condition().
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; core transfer logic with raw unchecked balance arithmetic and allowance decrement.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale limits and per-address _onSaleNum quota.
delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable; owner-only delegatecall to arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
_mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public; restricted by msg.sender==owner or a hardcoded address, overwrites balanceOf and sets canSale whitelist.
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of sale limits.
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop with unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only setter for tradeAddress whitelist entry.
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; computes Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Constructor of UniswapExchange; sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balances/allowance.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn(IERC20 token, bytes data) private; performs an arbitrary low-level call to a token contract.
ERC20._transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint amount) internal; SafeMath guarded balance updates used by the inherited ERC20.
ERC20._approve(address owner, address spender, uint amount) internal; writes the private _allowances mapping.
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf of UniswapExchange; raw token balances written without SafeMath.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spender approvals.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist flag consulted by ensure.
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount limit.
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount limit.
uint256 private _saleNum; per-address transfer quota.
address tradeAddress; mutable whitelist address set by setTradeAddress.
address private owner; privileged address checked across delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress.
uint public totalSupply; minted supply set in constructor.
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used in init and _mints.
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D; router address whitelisted in ensure.
mapping(address=>uint) private _balances of the inherited ERC20 implementation.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) private _allowances of the inherited ERC20 implementation.
msg.sender; caller controlled address used for authorization, allowance checks and balance ownership.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate: arbitrary external code executed in the context of this contract.
address(token).call(data) inside callOptionalReturn: unchecked low-level call to an arbitrary token.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath; underflow possible.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom without SafeMath; overflow possible.
total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend without overflow protection.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend without SafeMath; underflow possible.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from,_to,_value) as a mandatory gate.
ensure delegates the sale limit validation to condition().
ensure derives the whitelisted pair address through pairFor().
delegate performs a delegatecall to caller supplied address and calldata.
delegatecall executes arbitrary code in this contract context and can reenter delegate and other state-changing functions.
callOptionalReturn executes an unchecked low-level call to the token contract.
low-level call to an attacker controlled token can reenter transferFrom while balances and allowances are being updated.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting deployer privileges used by all owner-only functions.
transferFrom reads msg.sender to compare with _from and to charge allowance.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before the delegatecall, so caller identity controls a privileged sink.
_mints authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender to owner or a hardcoded external address, enabling privileged balance overwrite.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale configuration.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before transferring balances of msg.sender.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before mutating the whitelist address.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_value flows into an unchecked subtraction from balanceOf[_from].
_value flows into an unchecked addition to balanceOf[_to].
_from selects the balance slot reduced without SafeMath.
_to selects the balance slot increased without SafeMath.
unchecked subtraction mutates the public balanceOf mapping, allowing underflow.
unchecked addition mutates the public balanceOf mapping, allowing overflow.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length with no overflow check.
unchecked product is stored in the local total used for balance accounting.
the unchecked total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend underflowed subtraction mutates balanceOf.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw arithmetic.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] with raw arithmetic.
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals without overflow protection.
constructor writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
_transfer updates _balances using SafeMath guarded arithmetic.
_approve writes the _allowances allowance mapping.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, adding an address to the transfer whitelist.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an attacker influenced amount.
init writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
approve stores the requested allowance value.

normalization_plan.reason: _value is a formal parameter only meaningful inside transfer; fold it into the enclosing function node.
_to is a formal parameter only meaningful inside transfer; fold it into the enclosing function node.
_from is a formal parameter of transferFrom and carries no independent semantics.
_to is a formal parameter of transferFrom and carries no independent semantics.
_value is a formal parameter of transferFrom; merge into the function that consumes it.
_spender is only used within approve; fold into the function node.
_value is only used within approve; fold into the function node.
_from is a formal parameter of the internal whitelist gate ensure.
_to is a formal parameter of the internal whitelist gate ensure.
_value is a formal parameter of the internal whitelist gate ensure.
a is the delegatecall target parameter and belongs to delegate.
b is the delegatecall payload parameter and belongs to delegate.
spender is only meaningful inside _mints where balanceOf is overwritten.
addedValue is only meaningful inside _mints where balanceOf is overwritten.
saleNum configures _saleNum only inside init.
token configures _minSale only inside init.
maxToken configures _maxSale only inside init.
_tos drives the batchSend loop and has no meaning outside it.
_value is consumed by the unchecked multiplication inside batchSend.
addr is only used to write tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress.
_name is a constructor-only parameter assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol is a constructor-only parameter assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply is a constructor-only parameter used to compute totalSupply.
the local total is the value consumed by the unchecked subtraction in batchSend, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
i is a loop counter local to batchSend with no external semantics.
_UNI is a transient local computed and compared inside ensure.
